Corollary
Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0056 1. ch3:3.11\group ch03-classical-maximum-principle Under the hypotheses of Theorem 20, for every $\Omega '\Subset \Omega \subset \mathbb R^2$ there is $\kappa =\kappa (\Omega ,\Omega ',\mu )$ such that \begin{equation} \tag {3.26} \sup _{\Omega '}u\leq \kappa \inf _{\Omega '}u. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Join points of $\Omega '$ by a finite chain of disks compactly contained in $\Omega $ and iterate Theorem 20.

□

The disk argument also applies to \begin{equation} \tag {3.27} Lu=a^{ij}D_{ij}u+b^iD_i u+cu=0, \qquad c\leq 0,quad i,j=1,2, \end{equation} with constants depending additionally on the coefficient bounds and radius.
